title: Stack the status label in front of the card
goal: Sets z-index for positioned elements in the same stacking context.
summary: status tag precedes the background card in the DOM, but should visually cover the top right edge of the card.
tasks: Set the z-index of the .status layer to 2 and set the .card-face to 1.
retains existing positioning and overlapping positions.

example.code:
.back { position: absolute; z-index: 1; }
.front { position: absolute; z-index: 2; }
example.note: Higher-level positioned elements are drawn on top of lower-level elements in the same stacking context.

hint: starting style has added positioning to the two layers and declared z-index in their respective rules.
